note: DERIVED. Drafted on 2026-11-15 by an AI session under D34 of issue #77, for rotation B. D197 of issue #77 (inputs computed as AMG computes them, so the model is used as it was calibrated). The id, scope key crop and unit are those engine/residues/_parameters.py reads on main (RECORDS, CROP_SCOPE_KEY); the scope value is the crop_id of demonstration rotation B (D128). Verbatim text to compare, Clivot et al. (2019), printed p. 102: "Extra-root C inputs were calculated following the assumption made by Bolinder et al. (2007)", eq. 9 C_E = 0.65 x C_R. Arithmetic: step 1, root carbon 0-20 cm = 543.2 kg ha-1 (root_mass_at_harvest.wheat) x 0.40 (root_carbon_fraction.wheat) = 217.28 kg C ha-1; step 2, 217.28 x 0.65 = 141.232, rounded to 141.2 kg C ha-1. Options not taken (D197): the local rhizodeposition factor 0.54 (Pausch and Kuzyakov 2018). The dataset description says: "They are applicable for average French arable crop conditions." D192 and D197 of issue #77 take them as French defaults, not calibrated for Uruguay, and say so in the label. Per D161 no AI session writes a person's name in checked_by: the lead developer, or their delegate (D66), fills it after comparing the text with the source.
